entities.name: Terrent Amese
entities.description: A mythical human-shaped being, worshiped as a god, who created the first Jamuraan tiger warriors; whether he is a planeswalker or even real is unconfirmed.

entities.name: Ojanen
entities.description: The first tiger warrior, who led his tribe, realized Terrent Amese was no god, and rebelled against him.

entities.name: Ur-Drago
entities.description: A monster created by Terrent Amese to exterminate the tiger tribe; later defeated by Jedit Ojanen.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: A descendant of Ojanen who was magically transported back to defeat Ur-Drago and later led the cat warriors to a more enlightened society.

entities.name: Tiger warriors
entities.description: The Jamuraan cat warrior tribes created by Terrent Amese, who split into the Hooraree, Efravan, Khyyiani and Sulaki.

entities.name: Scarwood
entities.description: The wood on Jamuraa containing the Dark Heart of the Wood, which the tiger warriors were made to guard.

entities.name: The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale
entities.description: A place of worship and watch-post over the Dark Heart of the Wood built by the tiger warriors.

entities.name: Dark Heart of the Wood
entities.description: A place in Scarwood the tiger warriors were created to guard.

entities.name: Glyph of Life
entities.description: A white metal instrument like ram's horns held by Terrent Amese in depictions.

entities.name: Sukurvian Desert
entities.description: The desert where the fleeing tribe settled.

events.summary: Terrent Amese fuses man and tiger to create the first tribe of tiger warriors to guard the Dark Heart of the Wood.
events.quote: who created the first tribe of Jamuraan tiger warriors by fusing the essence of man and tiger.

events.summary: Ojanen leads the tribe in building the Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale as a place of worship and watch-post.
events.quote: Terrent Amese named the first tiger warrior Ojanen

events.summary: Ojanen realizes his people are slave labor and Terrent Amese no god, and rallies the tribe to seek independence.
events.quote: He rallied his tribe behind him and tried to obtain their independence from their creator.

events.summary: Terrent Amese curses the Ojanen line, creates Ur-Drago to exterminate the tribe, and disappears; Ojanen fights the beast while the tribe flees Scarwood.
events.quote: Terrent Amese cursed the Ojanen line and created the monster Ur-Drago to exterminate the tribe before disappearing, never to be seen again.

events.summary: Jedit Ojanen is magically transported to the duel's moment and defeats Ur-Drago himself.
events.quote: before Jedit Ojanen would be magically transported to this crucial point in time and defeat Ur-Drago himself.

events.summary: The tribe settles in the Sukurvian Desert and splinters into four bands.
events.quote: The tribe would settle in the Sukurvian Desert

events.summary: Jedit rediscovers the tribes' origins, and the four tribes make peace, return to Scarwood, rebuild the Tabernacle and found an empire.
events.quote: The four tribes would end up making peace with one another
